days.details: No ride after the weekend long ride. Strength A, about 25 min: goblet squats 3 × 10, Bulgarian split squats 3 × 8 each leg, Romanian deadlifts 3 × 10, plank 3 × 40 s, side plank 2 × 30 s each side. Use a dumbbell or kettlebell, or bodyweight. Stop 2 reps short of failure.
15 min easy, then 2 × 20 min at the top of Zone 3 with 5 min easy between. Seated, steady cadence 85–95.

Conversational pace. Flat route, keep the HR strap on. After the ride, Strength B, about 20 min: step-ups 3 × 10 each leg, single-leg glute bridges 3 × 12 each leg, calf raises 3 × 15, dead bugs 3 × 10. Light, so Thursday's hill repeats stay fresh.
Warm up 20 min, then 5 × 3 min hard on a steady climb, roll back down to recover. Kennesaw prep.
Off, or 30–40 min very easy if the legs want it.
55+ mi for the Eddington count. Eat every 45 min, drink a bottle an hour. Moved to Saturday so Sunday is a rain backup.
If Saturday rains out, ride the long ride today. Otherwise 45–60 min easy or off.
